artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact enumeration proving completeness of the four-I-component classification.
Deterministic output of the exact enumeration.

limitations: The theorem treats exactly four I-components. It does not classify \(J\ge5\) or resolve whether infinitely many infinitary harmonic numbers exist. The completeness proof is computer-assisted but finite, exact, and bounded a priori.
record_title: Exact classification of infinitary harmonic numbers with four I-components
